description: Source code for font handling in a graphics or UI library, including font loading, rendering, and cleanup functions using FreeType and OpenGL.

methods.name: lu5_init_freetype
methods.description: Initializes FreeType library within the lu5_State.

methods.name: lu5_load_font
methods.description: Loads a font from a file or memory, creates textures for characters, and sets font size.

methods.name: lu5_load_and_add_font
methods.description: Loads a font and adds it to the font list, returning the font object.

methods.name: lu5_measure_text
methods.description: Calculates width, height, and maximum bearing Y of a text string using a font.

methods.name: lu5_render_text
methods.description: Renders text at specified position with alignment and font.

methods.name: lu5_load_default_font
methods.description: Loads the default font and sets it as current.

methods.name: lu5_close_font
methods.description: Releases resources associated with a font.

methods.name: lu5_close_fonts
methods.description: Closes all fonts and frees resources.
